title: Assessment of ethylene dibromide, dibromochloropropane, other volatile organic compounds, radium isotopes, radon, and inorganic compounds in groundwater and spring water from the Crouch Branch and McQueen Branch aquifers near McBee, South Carolina, 2010-2012
citation: Landmeyer, J.E., and Campbell, B.G., 2014, Assessment of ethylene dibromide, dibromochloropropane, other volatile organic compounds, radium isotopes, radon, and inorganic compounds in groundwater and spring water from the Crouch Branch and McQueen Branch aquifers near McBee, South Carolina, 2010-2012: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Report SIR-2014-5114, map scale 1:91,000.
notes:
Water-quality report. Packet 1 covers the hydrogeologic setting (pp. 19, 21, 27), the well/spring table (table 3, p. 30) and well descriptions (pp. 29, 31). Wells/springs: one observation per table 3 row; label notes give county number and USGS site ID (site IDs are identifiers, no coordinates were computed). The aquifer column is stored as the interval unit. Table 1 chemistry and table 2 compound properties not recorded (not geologic). No reference list in this packet (it comes later).
Packet 2 (pp. 33-59) is mostly methods and water-chemistry tables (tables 4-6: field parameters, EDB/DBCP and other VOC concentrations) and plume maps; these are not geologic and were not recorded. Only hydrogeologic statements were recorded. Continues from packet 1.
Packet 3 (pp. 60-86) is mostly VOC, radium, radon and inorganic concentration tables (tables 6-10), trend graphs, and soil-gas sampler results (table 10, with sampler coordinates); not geologic, not recorded. Recorded only bedrock/aquifer statements and well screen notes. Continues from packet 2.
Packet 4 (pp. 87-110): soil-gas results, CFC apparent ages (table 11), dissolved gases (table 12), particle-tracking maps, summary, references. Apparent groundwater ages and chemistry not recorded (not geologic). References: only those on South Carolina geology/hydrogeology/groundwater were recorded; general chemistry, toxicology, methods and out-of-state references were skipped. Completes the document.
